title_zh: 执行暂缓不等于安全漏洞判定
principle: Automatic review rejection, wording matches, ordinary debugging failures and environment prerequisites are distinct records. None alone is a verified security finding or an assessment of user intent.
ordinary_failures: Compilation errors, managed exceptions, cancellation and waiting are recorded as debugging outcomes; they do not by themselves establish a security vulnerability.
existing_holds: Existing automatic-review and user-requested holds are preserved. This clarification does not authorize a retry of a held workload.
change: The public review section is labeled execution holds and identifies the source of each hold; execution routing rules are unchanged.
